Alternative device-client profile

Source: tidalapi 0.8.11, publicly distributed Config device-client defaults.
https://pypi.org/project/tidalapi/0.8.11/
https://github.com/EbbLabs/python-tidal
Upstream license: LGPL-3.0; license text in tidalapi-LICENSE.txt.

AlternativeClientProfile.kt contains the shared device-client configuration
from this library. It contains no personal TIDAL password, access token,
refresh token or personal developer client secret. No NOORwave binary was
decompiled and no private credentials were extracted from another app.

The Android authentication, secure-storage and routing implementation in
this project was written for this prototype rather than copied from
tidalapi or Tides-WearOS.
